scope: one released MLP; holdout concerns reliability fitting, not backbone training or novel survey-platform independence
assessment_cohort: all 163 metadata-selected candidate cells with identical-coordinate released 52-feature vectors; 301 plots, 16 sites
other_candidate_cells: 46 cells remain outside this study because their full input bridge is incomplete; no performance-based exclusion
calibration_source: only original E1 probability/risk-calibration rows, historically consumed development labels; never E1 assessment rows
label_universe: 2453 public SAGE classes with unambiguous NEON dictionary mappings, intersected with each cell's published native-range mask
unknown_taxa: unresolved/unmapped/qualified records mask compatible model genera, then family if genus unavailable, then all classes; known positives remain known; no change to frozen predicted sets or confidence features
scoring: F1 on known labels only: remove unknown-class predictions from the scoring denominator, without re-decoding or refitting
quality_coverage_filter: predeclared missing-label eligibility, not model-performance filtering; report all attrition and limit inference to scorable inventories
affine_calibration: least-squares quality on SDC on risk-calibration rows; slope constrained to >=1e-9, predictions clipped to [0,1]
quota_groups: site by single-plot versus multiple-plot cell; identical largest-remainder allocations among scorable cells
primary_hypothesis: HGB can improve transported magnitude MSE relative to the training-mean reference while losing quota-constrained F1 to SDC
joint_success: at least 100 cells/12 sites; MSE gain >=0.001 with 97.5% site-bootstrap lower bound >0; F1 difference <=-0.002 with 97.5% upper bound <0
secondary: affine SDC MSE and raw SDC MSE
taxonomy/score attrition and site-level point contrasts
GPU_budget: one private inference job <=20 minutes; no NEON token, target labels or competition submission
claim_limit: a locally locked empirical source/site transfer test of one fixed model and one calibrated class universe; not a new algorithm, all-species occupancy truth, unseen-training-location result, or secret benchmark
